safety_lead_time.comparison_action: decrease from SAP 3.0 days to recommended 0.78 days

narrative: Material PL2__ME04FCDD exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.55) with a mild declining trend of -0.53%/day across 96 working days. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=1.40) due to one outlier receipt of 2.43 days against a typical range of 0.07-0.32 days. The (r,Q) continuous-review policy is selected because the very short effective lead time (0.65 days) and high demand variance make cycle-stock consolidation the dominant cost lever. The EOQ of 8,335 units is storage-capped to 2,146 units, which still delivers 91.7% cost savings versus the current MOQ-driven SAP policy.

research_insights.selection_rationale: High CV and erratic demand favour a continuous-review trigger (r) to avoid stockouts during demand spikes; EOQ minimises ordering+holding cost subject to the storage cap. The MOQ of 166 is satisfied comfortably by the capacity-constrained Q=2,146.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap binds: unconstrained EOQ (8,335) is 3.5x the available space. The capped Q=2,146 increases order frequency from the theoretical optimum (~8 orders/yr) to ~30 orders/yr, raising annual ordering cost from ~$600 to $2,250. Service level remains intact as SS+Q=2,347 ≤ max_storage.
